correctness.rationale: All block lengths and all starts are addressed by exact Parikh counts from binary pair identities. For each fixed gap the correlation average is proved to exist via dyadic recurrences and a dyadic-block approximation for arbitrary prefix lengths. The triple-equality identity yields both rational density formulas. A complete induction characterizes equality of correlation extremes and all odd special cases. The extracted standalone Python checker matched 295046 bounded assertions; finite checks are auxiliary rather than infinite proofs.
